segments.text: Ok so this is the Components and surfaces page for OpenAI Agents, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page says the runtime gives the agent a render UI tool, umm, but the UI it draws never shows up.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc, step three only, like the page says.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for a card with a price chart, it should render in the chat, but no surface shows, the reply is empty or just says sorry.
So basically, the agent calls render UI, but nothing renders and the reply is empty, both runs the same.
So yeah, please take a look and fix this.
